summary_bullets: Prevent plan-command auto-fix from dispatching vendors on empty composed plans.
Clarify Step 5c recovery docs for Fix-and-retry and proceed-anyway validation boundaries.
commit_message:
Guard design autofix for empty composed plans

Skip plan-command auto-fix dispatch when the target plan file is empty, returning the no-dispatch KVs with an empty-target validator status.

Clarify Step 5c recovery docs so Fix-and-retry reruns validation and --skip-validate only bypasses the plan-command validator, not the missing-or-empty guard.
